title: 第5章 巨腾集团
content_zh:
场中虽是两人比武，但可看的却只一人。曹虎来来去去这十几招，大家委实都瞧得厌了。岳胜的拳招却变幻百出，花式似乎无穷无尽。一套燕青拳奈何不了对方，忽然拳法又变，使出一套鲁智深醉跌。但见他如疯如癫，似醉似狂，忽而卧倒，忽而跃起，“罗汉斜卧”、“仙人渴盹”，这路拳法似是瞎打乱踢，其实精彩之极。这时曹虎那十几招笨拳却渐渐不管事了，对方拳脚来路也看不明白，不由心下着慌。猛听岳胜喝声：“着！”一脚“鲤鱼翻身搅丝腿”正好踢在他腰间。曹虎痛得弯下了腰。

    岳胜知对方功夫了得，这脚虽中要害，只怕仍难令他身受重伤。倘若平常比武较量，胜了这腿自也可以收手，但这番争斗关系三百万货物，怎容敌人喘息片刻？若是争端重起，也未必定能再胜，当下得理不让人，纵身上前，一腿拐子脚又往他后心踢去。

    群盗齐声大哗。曹虎忽然一脚钩腿反踢，来势变幻无方，岳胜虽阅历丰富，竟见不及此，给他这腿踢中小腹，仰天一跤直摔出去。岳青与周银兵双双抢上扶起。但见他面如白纸，连声咳嗽，只说：“拼死护货！”

    群盗人多，除曹虎外虽无高手，但岳青与周银兵要分心照料岳胜，给群盗两下里一攻，情势登见危急。温文新拔出单刀，叫道：“三位警官，咱们动手吧！”田星辰说：“好，赶走强盗再说。”四个生力军加入战团。

    温文新见岳青给两名盗伙用武器封住了，渐渐施展不开手脚，当即抢上，喝道：“男子汉欺负姑娘，还要两个打一个，不害臊么？”唰的一刀，往那高个盗伙头上砍去。那人挥鞭招架，几个回合，温文新刀中夹掌，左手一掌抹在他胸口，将他击得直掼出去。岳青喘息说：“行了，这一个让我来料理。”温文新一笑退开，去帮助周银兵，三刀两掌，又打发了一名盗伙。周银兵感激之余，很钦佩干爸眼光，这位少堡主的武功果然远胜自己。

    这么一来，厅上情势变换，群盗纷纷败退，抢着往门口奔出。猛听一人清声长啸，叫道：“大家住手！我有话说。”众人斗得正紧，没人理会。温文新突见人影一晃，一人伸掌在面前摇动，当即举刀削去，那人右手一钩一带，已将他单刀夺过往地下摔落。温文新大惊，急忙跃后，瞧那人时，却是那服饰华贵的男子。

    那男子大踏步走入人丛，双手钩拿拍打，只听叮叮当当响声不绝，武器落了一地，都让他施展小擒拿手法夺过抛落。群盗与物流师傅们惊骇之下各自跃开，呆呆望着他。曹虎一愕，忽然记起了十余年前之事，叫道：“李董！是你？”那男子想不起他是谁，好奇问：“你认得我？”曹虎笑着说：“十三年前在天竺山，小的服侍过您。”那男子低头一想，恍然记起，说道：“是了，你是那个医生！怎么学了一身武功，做起寨主来啦？”曹虎上前请了个安说：“多谢您栽培。”

    这男子正是巨腾集团董事长李丰粮。

    李丰粮双目自左至右在众人脸上缓缓扫过，然后又自右至左地横扫过来，再向天井中倾盆而下的大雨望了一眼，眼光终于停在货车上，说道：“老曹，今天的买卖你可是赔定啦。”曹虎陪笑说：“您别见怪，也是弟兄们少口饭吃，走投无路，这才干起这没本钱买卖来。我们改过自新，不敢忘了李董的恩德。”李丰粮哈哈大笑说：“怎么跟我闹起虚文来啦？老曹，你拿五十万走，够不够使了？”曹虎一怔，陪笑说：“您老人家开玩笑啦。”李丰粮说：“开什么玩笑？这里三百万，我拿一半一百五十万，余下的你拿五十万，还有一百万你说怎么分？”

    曹虎喜出望外，忙说：“您老人家一并随手带去就是了，还分什么？”李丰粮摇头说：“那不成话，这哪里还有江湖义气？适才我们进来避雨，我……我……我夫人衣服湿了……”那美妇听他说“我夫人”三字，脸上一红，神态微现忸怩，向李丰粮微微一笑。李丰粮报以一笑，继续说：“海安物流这位姑娘借衣服给她，这番情分不能不报，咱们给岳姑娘留五十万。还有，三位警官在此，见者有份，每人分十万两。余下二十万，就送给此间主人。你说我这样分法公不公道？”曹虎连连鼓掌，大叫：“公道之极，公道之极！我早说李董是天下第一等慷慨豪爽的大英雄。”

    岳胜、周银兵、岳青等听李丰粮侃侃而谈，旁若无人，倒似这三百万货物已是他囊中之物一般。岳胜身受重伤，这么一气，更险欲晕去。周银兵连问：“怎么办？怎么办？”岳青怒道：“什么怎么办！”弯腰拾起地下单刀，叫道：“姓李的，你当我们是死人吗！”说着扬起单刀，径往李丰粮扑去。

    李丰粮笑着说：“你别逼我动手，我夫人可要喝醋的。”那美妇啐了一口，笑骂：“贫嘴！”但似对他轻薄口吻甚为喜爱。岳青听他言语无礼，更是恼怒，上步一刀，拦腰横砍。李丰粮笑着说：“哎哟，不好，我夫人可不许我跟女人打架。”手指在她刀背上一击，岳青拿捏不住，脱手撤刀。李丰粮手法快极，右手抢过刀柄，左手已拿住她手腕，举起刀来，作势要往她头颈中砍下，口中却叹道：“似这般羞花闭月貌，怎叫我不做惜玉怜香人！”

    温文新和周银兵见他戏弄岳青，双双抢出。温文新右手一扬，一枝金钱镖取他左身。周银兵急了，来不及拾取地下武器，飞脚就踢他后心。李丰粮倏地回身，撤刀擒拿，抓住他足踝，往上一提。周银兵身子倒转，只感腿上一阵剧痛，失声大叫，却是那枝金钱镖打进了他右腿。李丰粮挥手抖出，周银兵的身子犹如一柄扫帚般横扫出去，正撞在岳青腿上，两人跌在一起。众人见他戏耍二人，如弄婴儿，哪里还敢上前？

    李丰粮说：“老曹，你把货物就照我说的那么分了，匀辆车给我，我们两口子身有急事，得冒雨赶路。”曹虎大喜，连声答应。群盗从货车中取出货物，一半一百五十万堆成一大堆，此外五十万的堆了两堆，三堆十万的、一堆二十万的，分别堆在地下，向司机喝道：“乖乖赶路吧！”

    北道上有规矩，绿林豪客劫货抢银，却不伤害司机，甚至跑腿费和伙食费也依常例照给，但若司机不听嘱咐，自然又作别论。司机们见了这等情势，哪敢不依，将一百五十万货物装上了车子，冒着大雨，将货车一辆辆运出去。

    岳胜见货车出去一辆，心里就发一阵疼，只见一辆货车赶到厅前，司机开了车门，李丰粮扶着美妇便要上车。只要货车一行，岳胜就身败名裂，倾家荡产，一世辛苦付于流水了。他颤巍巍站起，突然纵身叫道：“我和你拼了！”双手犹如铁钩，猛往李丰粮脸上抓去。那美妇看得害怕，吓得大声惊叫。李丰粮侧身出掌，击向他肩头。岳胜倘若未受重伤，这掌自然打他不着，但此时全身筋骨不听使唤，眼见掌到，竟然不能闪避，砰的一声飞起，向院子中跌了出去。

    猛听一人嗓子低沉，嘿嘿嘿三下冷笑。

    这三声冷笑传进厅来，李丰粮和那美妇顿时便如听见了世上最可怕的声音一般，二人面如白纸，身子发颤。李丰粮出力推那美妇背心，将那美妇推入车中，飞身而起，跨上一旁的骏马，双腿急夹，挥鞭催马快走。哪知他连连挥鞭，这高头骏马只跨出两步，突然停住，再也不能向前半尺。

    众人站在厅门口，从水帘一般的大雨中望出去。只见一个高大瘦削的大汉，背上背着一个小女孩，左手轻轻扯住骏马的后缰，右手牢牢按住那辆车。那匹骏马给李丰粮催得急了，低头弓腰，四蹄一起发劲。司机也在拼命开车。但大汉拉着骏马、按着车后，骏马和车竟似钉牢在地下一般，动也不动。

    那大汉冷笑一声。李丰粮尚自迟疑，车中美妇已跨出车来，向那大汉瞧也不瞧，昂然走进厅去。李丰粮慢慢下车，也跟着进厅。他全身给雨淋得湿透，却似丝毫不觉，目光呆滞，失魂落魄一般。那美妇招手叫他过去，坐在她身边。

    那大汉大踏步进厅，坐在火堆旁，向旁人一眼不瞧，将背上的女孩轻轻放下。那女孩约莫五六岁年纪，双颊通红，闭着双眼。那大汉怕冷坏了女孩，抱着她在火边烤火。那女孩正自沉沉熟睡，脸色白里透红，甚是可爱，长长的睫毛旁却挂着两颗泪珠。

    岳青、周银兵和温文新三人扶着岳胜起来，见李丰粮对那大汉如此害怕，都是又惊又喜。岳青问：“爸爸，你伤处还好么？这……这人是谁？”岳胜说：“他……他就是……射……射阳名……侠……射阳名侠秦英豪……”一句话刚说完，已痛得晕了过去。大厅上，海安物流的师傅们集在东首，曹虎与群盗集在西首，三警员与温文新站在椅子后，各人目光都瞧着秦英豪、李丰粮与美妇三人。

    秦英豪凝视怀中的女孩，脸上爱怜横溢，充满着慈爱和柔情，众人若不是适才见到他一手抓住大车，一手扯住骏马，端得神力惊人，真难相信此人身负绝世武功。

    那美妇神态自若，呆呆望着火堆，嘴角边挂着一丝冷笑，只有极细心之人，才见到她嘴唇微微颤动，显得心里甚为不安。

    李丰粮脸如白纸，望着院子中的大雨。

    三个人的目光瞧着三处，谁也不瞧谁一眼，各自安安静静坐着，一言不发。但三人心中，却如波涛汹涌，有大哀伤，有大决心，也有大恐惧。
content_en:
Although there are two people competing in the field, there is only one person visible.Everyone was really tired of watching Cao Hu's dozen or so moves.Yue Sheng's boxing moves were ever-changing, and his tricks seemed endless.A set of Yanqing boxing could not do anything to the opponent, but suddenly the boxing technique changed again, and a set of Lu Zhishen was used.But I saw that he was crazy, drunk and crazy, lying down and jumping up, "arhat lying down" and "immortal thirsty for a nap". This boxing technique seemed to be random kicks, but in fact it was extremely exciting.At this time, Cao Hu's dozens of stupid punches gradually stopped working. He couldn't understand the origin of the opponent's punches and couldn't help but panic.Suddenly, he heard Yue Sheng shouting: "Hold on!" and kicked him right in the waist with a "Carp Turning Over and Stirring Kick".Cao Hu bent down in pain.
Yue Sheng knew that the opponent's kung fu was very good. Even though the kick hit a vital point, it was unlikely to cause serious injury to him.If it were a normal martial arts contest, I would have stopped if I won. But with three million goods at stake in this fight, how could we allow the enemy to take a breather?If the dispute happened again, there was no guarantee that he would be able to win again. At that moment, he refused to let anyone deal with him, so he stepped forward and kicked him in the back with his crooked leg.
The thieves shouted in unison.Cao Hu suddenly kicked back with a hook leg, and the force of the attack was unpredictable. Although Yue Sheng had a lot of experience, he didn't see it. He kicked him in the lower abdomen and fell to the sky.Yue Qing and Zhou Yinbing both rushed to help him up.But when he saw that his face was as white as paper and he coughed repeatedly, he only said: "Fight to the death to protect the goods!"
There were many bandits, and although there were no masters except Cao Hu, Yue Qing and Zhou Yinbing had to focus on taking care of Yue Sheng, giving the bandits two attacks and one attack at a time. The situation became critical.Wen Wenxin drew his single sword and shouted: "Three police officers, let's do it!" Tian Xingchen said: "Okay, let's drive away the bandits." Four new troops joined the battle group.
Wen Wenxin saw Yue Qing being blocked by two thieves with weapons, and gradually couldn't use his hands and feet, so he immediately grabbed him and shouted: "A man bullies a girl, and he has to beat two of them. Aren't you ashamed?" With a sharp knife, he chopped off the tall thieves' head.The man swung his whip to parry, and after a few rounds, Wen Wen's new sword was caught in his palm, and he wiped his chest with the palm of his left hand, knocking him out.Yue Qing gasped and said, "Okay, let me take care of this one." Wen Wenxin smiled and stepped away, going to help Zhou Yinbing, with three swords and two palms, he dispatched another gangster.Zhou Yinbing was grateful and admired his godfather's vision. The young castle master's martial arts skills were indeed far better than his own.
As a result, the situation in the hall changed, and the thieves retreated one after another, rushing towards the door.Suddenly I heard a person shouting loudly and shouting: "Everyone, stop! I have something to say." Everyone was fighting fiercely, and no one paid attention.Wen Wenxin suddenly saw a silhouette of a person shaking his hand in front of his face. He immediately raised his knife to cut it off. The man's right hand hooked and snatched the knife away from him and threw him to the ground.Wen Wenxin was shocked and hurriedly jumped back. When he looked at the person, he saw that it was a man in luxurious clothes.
The man strode into the crowd and slapped the hook with both hands. There was a constant clanging sound. The weapon fell to the ground, and he used small grappling techniques to grab it and throw it away.The thieves and logistics masters jumped away in horror and stared at him blankly.Cao Hu was stunned, and suddenly remembered what happened more than ten years ago, and shouted: "Director Li! Is that you?" The man couldn't remember who he was, and asked curiously: "Do you recognize me?" Cao Hu said with a smile: "Thirteen years ago in Tianzhu Mountain, the little boyI served you." The man lowered his head and suddenly remembered, "Yes, you are the doctor!How come you learned martial arts and became the leader of the village?" Cao Hu stepped forward and said, "Thank you for your cultivation."
This man is Li Fengliang, chairman of Juteng Group.
Li Fengliang's eyes slowly swept over everyone's faces from left to right, and then from right to left. He glanced at the heavy rain pouring in the courtyard, and finally stopped at the truck and said, "Old Cao, you have to pay for today's business." Cao Hu laughed and said, "Don't be surprised, it's brothers who have little food to eat and are desperate, so they start this business without capital. Let's change it."Don't dare to forget Director Li's kindness." Li Fengliang laughed and said, "Why are you making a fuss with me?Old Cao, is it enough for you to take 500,000?" Cao Hu was startled and said with a smile, "Are you kidding?Here is 3 million, I will take half of it, and you will take 500,000.How do you divide it?"
Cao Hu was overjoyed and said hurriedly: "You can just take it with me, old man. What else do you need to pay for it?" Li Fengliang shook his head and said, "That's nonsense. Where is the sense of loyalty here? Just now we came in to take shelter from the rain, and I...I...my wife's clothes got wet..." When the beautiful woman heard him say "my wife", her face turned red, her expression became slightly coy, and she smiled at Li Fengliang.Li Fengliang responded with a smile and continued: "This girl from Haian Logistics lent her clothes. I have to repay this kindness. Let's leave 500,000 yuan for Miss Yue. Also, there are three police officers here. Anyone who sees it will have a share. Each of them will get a hundred thousand taels."The remaining 200,000 yuan will be given to the owner here.Do you think my division of law is fair?" Cao Hu clapped his hands and shouted: "Extremely fair, extremely fair!I have long said that Director Li is the most generous and generous hero in the world."
Yue Sheng, Zhou Yinbing, Yue Qing and others listened to Li Fengliang's talk as if no one else was around, as if the three million goods were already in his pocket.Yue Sheng was seriously injured, and he was so angry that he almost fainted.Zhou Yinbing asked repeatedly: "What to do? What to do?" Yue Qing said angrily: "What to do!" He bent down and picked up the single sword from the ground, shouting: "Li, do you think we are dead!" He raised the single sword and rushed towards Li Fengliang.
Li Fengliang said with a smile: "Don't force me to do anything, my wife will be jealous." The beautiful woman spat and scolded with a smile: "You are a mouthful!" But she seemed to like his frivolous tone very much.Yue Qing became even more angry when he heard his rude words. He stepped forward and slashed across the waist with his sword.Li Fengliang smiled and said, "Oh, no, my wife won't allow me to fight with women." He hit her on the back of the knife with his finger, and Yue Qing couldn't hold it back and withdrew the knife.Li Fengliang's technique was very fast. He grabbed the handle of the knife with his right hand, and already held her wrist with his left hand. He raised the knife and tried to chop it off on her head and neck, but he sighed: "How can I not be a person who cherishes jade and loves fragrance with such a shy beauty?"
Wen Wenxin and Zhou Yinbing saw him teasing Yue Qing and both rushed out.Wen Wenxin raised his right hand, and a money dart was taken from his left side.Zhou Yinbing was so anxious that he kicked him in the back before he could pick up the underground weapon.Li Fengliang turned around quickly, withdrew his knife to capture him, grabbed his ankle, and lifted him up.Zhou Yinbing turned upside down and felt a sharp pain in his leg. He screamed, but it was the money dart that hit his right leg.Li Fengliang waved his hand, and Zhou Yinbing's body swept out like a broom, hitting Yue Qing's leg, and the two fell together.When everyone saw him playing with the two of them like babies, how could they dare to come forward?
Li Fengliang said: "Old Cao, just divide the goods as I said, and give me a car. We are in an emergency and have to travel in the rain." Cao Hu was overjoyed and agreed repeatedly.The group of thieves took out the goods from the truck, and piled half of the goods into one big pile of 1.5 million. In addition, there were two piles of 500,000, three piles of 100,000, and one pile of 200,000. They piled them on the ground and shouted to the driver: "Go on your way!"
There are rules on the North Road. Green forest tycoons rob goods and steal money, but do not harm the driver. Even errand fees and food expenses are paid as usual. However, if the driver does not obey the instructions, it will naturally be different.Seeing this situation, the drivers dared not to obey. They loaded 1.5 million worth of goods into the truck and braved the heavy rain to transport the trucks out one by one.
Yue Sheng felt a pain in his heart when he saw a truck coming out. He saw a truck rushing to the front of the hall, the driver opened the door, and Li Fengliang supported the beautiful woman to get in the truck.As long as the truck travels, Yue Sheng will be ruined, his family will be ruined, and his life's hard work will be wasted.He stood up tremblingly, suddenly jumped up and shouted: "I will fight with you!" His hands were like iron hooks, and he fiercely grabbed Li Fengliang's face.The beautiful woman was so frightened that she screamed loudly.Li Fengliang turned sideways and struck his shoulder with his palm.If Yue Sheng was not seriously injured, the palm would naturally not be able to hit him, but at this moment, his muscles and bones were not functioning properly. When he saw the palm coming, he was unable to dodge. He flew up with a bang and fell out into the yard.
Suddenly I heard someone's voice grow low and he sneered three times.
When these three sneers came into the hall, Li Fengliang and the beautiful woman immediately felt as if they had heard the most terrifying sound in the world. Their faces were as white as paper and their bodies were trembling.Li Fengliang pushed the beautiful woman's vest, pushed the beautiful woman into the car, flew up, climbed onto the horse beside him, clamped his legs together, and whipped the horse to hurry up.Unexpectedly, he whipped his whip repeatedly, and the tall horse only took two steps, suddenly stopped, and could no longer move forward half a foot.
Everyone stood at the door of the hall, looking out from the heavy rain like a curtain of water.I saw a tall, thin man with a little girl on his back. His left hand gently held the back rein of the horse, and his right hand firmly held down the car.The horse was so driven by Li Fengliang that it lowered its head, bowed its waist, and worked hard with all four hooves.The driver was also driving hard.But the big man pulled the horse and pressed the back of the cart. The horse and the cart seemed to be nailed to the ground and could not move.
The big man sneered.Li Fengliang was still hesitating, but the beautiful woman in the car had already stepped out of the car and walked into the hall proudly without even looking at the big man.Li Fengliang slowly got out of the car and followed him into the hall.His whole body was soaked by the rain, but he didn't seem to notice it at all. His eyes were dull and he seemed lost.The beautiful woman waved him over and sat next to her.
